purpose: Teach: 附帯/インテリジェンス/ウェブページ/所信/タイマー/ハンディ/モデリング/クリアー

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 附帯施設の管理も委託先を見直しましょう
lines.en: Let's review the vendors for the ancillary facilities management.
lines.style: Crisp, purposeful opening. Clear authority without harshness. Businesslike pace. Expects agreement — no question mark in the air.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。インテリジェンスチームを編成します
lines.en: Yes. I'll form an intelligence team to handle it.
lines.style: Prompt, affirming. Light nod in the voice. Professional but warm — showing he's already thinking forward. Efficient, no wasted syllables.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: ウェブページの動線を改善しましょう
lines.en: We should improve the webpage navigation flow.
lines.style: Same crisp authority as the first line. Steady hands — this is methodical review. Forward momentum, no hesitation.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新社長所信を全社員に伝えます
lines.en: Understood. I'll brief all staff on the new president's vision statement.
lines.style: Confirmation tone, quick to action. Small emphasis on the scope — 'all staff' — showing he recognizes the scale. Reliable, no edge.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: オフィス照明のタイマー設定を見直しましょう
lines.en: Let's revisit the timer settings on the office lighting.
lines.style: Same measured authority. Slightly lower energy than the first proposal — operational detail rather than strategic — but still clear intent. Matter-of-fact.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。ハンディスキャナーを倉庫に追加します
lines.en: Understood. I'll add handheld scanners to the warehouse inventory.
lines.style: Quick acknowledgment. Practical focus — he's already mapping the action. No flourish, just competence. Steady breath.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 需要予測のモデリングを更新しましょう
lines.en: Let's update the demand forecasting model.
lines.style: Back to strategic weight. Calm, authoritative opening. She's building a list of improvements with absolute clarity. Slight emphasis on 'update' — refresh, not overhaul.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。期限内に課題をクリアーします
lines.en: Yes. I'll make sure we clear all issues within the deadline.
lines.style: Final confirmation — slight finality in the tone. Reassuring without being defensive. He's committing. Straight through, no trailing off.
